test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The air quality is so bad ______it becomes difficult to breathe.
solution: The correct answer is '**that**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct conjunction to complete the sentence "The air quality is so bad ______ it becomes difficult to breathe" is "**that**". • The conjunction "**that**" is used to introduce a clause that is the result or the consequence of the main clause. • The other options: "**when**", "**as**", and "**since**" do not fit the context as appropriately. ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'. **Complete Sentence:** The air quality is so bad** that **it becomes difficult to breathe. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **When (जब)**: is used to refer to the time at which something happens. • **As (जैसे)**: is often used to indicate similarity or manner. • **Since (चूंकि/जब से)**: is used to indicate a point in time or reason. c1:Td71,
